summary: Expose metadata-only native harness questions and a person-authorized positions-only harness.answer contract with typed refusals and question-scoped retry receipts

replay.detail: No replay or startup projection rebuild.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes, triggers, schema version or additional claim fields. Reuses the harness-question observation and resolution claims.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change beyond the prerequisite harness-question claims release.

compatibility.detail: Additive client-v0 metadata resource, list/get reads, harness.answer action and typed invalid-answer/not-answerable details. Stored and transmitted answers contain ids and positions only, never question text, option labels, Other text or notes. Older clients retain the unknown-resource fallback; older daemons do not advertise the new action. No additional claim fields or replication digest change beyond the prerequisite.

manual.detail: No adapter is wired by this release. Availability reports adapter_missing, and answering refuses before any durable write until a settle adapter is supplied.

recovery.detail: Answer receipts expire with resolved questions after 24 hours. Retry the same question, action identity, idempotency key and parameters; a new key after resolution returns already_resolved.
